title: Projective sheaf models from lisse residue cohomology on a weakly contractible affine
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and residue field $k=R/(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $S$ be an affine weakly contractible scheme for its small pro-etale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], meaning that evaluation on $S$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets to a surjection. For each open subscheme $U\subseteq S$, put $B_U=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/\varpi^n)_U$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_S))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that $K$ is derived complete for its quotient tower [def-weil-derived-complete] and that its derived residue reduction $K_1=K\otimes^L_{B_S}k_S$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] has locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] constructible cohomology sheaves with only finitely many nonzero degrees [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and has finite Tor amplitude locally: there are integers $a\leq b$ such that for every pro-etale $U\to S$ and every $k_U$-module sheaf $L$, the cohomology sheaves of $(K_1|_U)\otimes^L_{k_U}L$ vanish outside $[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-tensor, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Then there is a finite disjoint open covering $S=\coprod_i U_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that, for each $i$, $K|_{U_i}$ is represented by a bounded complex of $B_{U_i}$-module sheaves whose terms are direct summands of finite sums $B_{U_i}^{\oplus r}$ (each summand has inclusion and retraction maps whose composite is its identity). The differentials are arbitrary $B_{U_i}$-linear sheaf maps; no constancy of their matrix entries over $R$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09C3 (lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex): weakly contractible affine, Noetherian coefficient ring, derived completeness, constructible locally constant residue cohomology and locally finite Tor dimension; finite disjoint open cover and completed finite projective module terms. Specialize Λ=R and I=(varpi); restriction of scalars between complete constant and completed coefficients is the equivalence of Tag 099I in algebraization.tex (lemma-restriction-derived-complete-equivalence). Tag 0990 (lemma-proetale-enough-w-contractible) supplies the covering context.
